mapper.insert: insert into instance(id, application_id, environment_id, nickname, hostname, process_id, runtime, status, labels_json, last_seen_at, created_at, updated_at) values (#{id}, #{applicationId}, #{environmentId}, #{nickname}, #{hostname}, #{processId}, #{runtime}, #{status}, #{labelsJson}, #{now}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: update instance set nickname = #{nickname}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into instance(id, application_id, environment_id, nickname, hostname, process_id, runtime, status, labels_json, last_seen_at, created_at, updated_at, process_start_id, jvm_started_at, java_version, load_mode, agent_version, capabilities_json, lease_expires_at, registration_status) values (#{id}, #{applicationId}, #{environmentId}, #{nickname}, #{hostname}, #{processId}, #{runtime}, #{status}, #{labelsJson}, #{now}, #{now}, #{now}, #{processStartId}, #{jvmStartedAt}, #{javaVersion}, #{loadMode}, #{agentVersion}, #{capabilitiesJson}, #{leaseExpiresAt}, #{registrationStatus})
mapper.update: update instance set application_id = #{applicationId}, environment_id = coalesce(#{environmentId}, environment_id), hostname = #{hostname}, process_id = #{processId}, runtime = #{runtime}, status = case when coalesce(#{environmentId}, environment_id) is null then 'PENDING_ASSIGNMENT' else 'ACTIVE' end, last_seen_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, process_start_id = #{processStartId}, jvm_started_at = #{jvmStartedAt}, java_version = #{javaVersion}, load_mode = #{loadMode}, agent_version = #{agentVersion}, capabilities_json = #{capabilitiesJson}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, registration_status = case when coalesce(#{environmentId}, environment_id) is null then 'PENDING_ASSIGNMENT' else 'ASSIGNED' end where id = #{id}

mapper.insert: insert into agent_instance(id, instance_id, sidecar_id, status, agent_version, bootstrap_version, listen_host, listen_port, token_hash, capabilities_json, last_heartbeat_at, created_at, updated_at, lease_expires_at) values (#{id}, #{instanceId}, #{sidecarId}, #{status}, #{agentVersion}, #{bootstrapVersion}, #{listenHost}, #{listenPort}, #{tokenHash}, #{capabilitiesJson}, #{now}, #{now}, #{now}, #{leaseExpiresAt})
mapper.update: update agent_instance set status = 'ACTIVE', sidecar_id = coalesce(#{sidecarId}, sidecar_id), agent_version = #{agentVersion}, bootstrap_version = #{bootstrapVersion}, listen_host = #{listenHost}, listen_port = #{listenPort}, capabilities_json = #{capabilitiesJson}, last_heartbeat_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt} where id = #{id}

update rollout_instance_execution set status = 'ABANDONED', error_message = '目标实例已被运行时清理', finished_at = coalesce(finished_at, #{now}), updated_at = #{now} where instance_id = #{instanceId} and status <> 'ABANDONED'

update operation_plan op set status = 'ABANDONED', version = version + 1, terminal_source = 'INSTANCE_GONE', terminal_reason = '目标实例已被运行时清理，计划仅保留历史痕迹', updated_by = 'runtime-maintenance', updated_at = #{now} where op.status <> 'ABANDONED' and exists (select 1 from rollout_instance_execution rie where rie.operation_plan_id = op.id and rie.instance_id = #{instanceId}) and not exists (select 1 from rollout_instance_execution rie join instance i on i.id = rie.instance_id where rie.operation_plan_id = op.id and rie.instance_id <> #{instanceId} and i.status not in ('OFFLINE', 'ARCHIVED'))
mapper.insert: insert into agent_instance(id, instance_id, sidecar_id, status, agent_version, bootstrap_version, listen_host, listen_port, token_hash, capabilities_json, last_heartbeat_at, created_at, updated_at) values (#{id}, #{instanceId}, #{sidecarId}, #{status}, #{agentVersion}, #{bootstrapVersion}, #{listenHost}, #{listenPort}, #{tokenHash}, #{capabilitiesJson}, #{now}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: update agent_instance set status = #{status}, last_heartbeat_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt} where id = #{id}

update instance set status = case when environment_id is null then 'PENDING_ASSIGNMENT' else 'ACTIVE' end, last_seen_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt} where id = (select instance_id from agent_instance where id = #{agentId})
mapper.select: select instance_id from agent_instance where id = #{agentId}
mapper.insert: insert into agent_heartbeat(id, agent_id, status, metrics_json, received_at) values (#{id}, #{agentId}, #{status}, #{metricsJson}, #{receivedAt})
mapper.select: select distinct op.* from operation_plan op join rollout_instance_execution rie on rie.operation_plan_id = op.id join rule_version rv on rv.rule_id = op.resource_id and rv.version = op.resource_version where rie.instance_id = #{instanceId} and op.status = 'UNLOADED' and op.terminal_source = 'AGENT_GONE' and op.resource_type = 'rule' and rv.status = 'ENABLED' order by op.updated_at, op.id
mapper.update: update operation_plan set status = 'RUNNING', version = version + 1, terminal_source = '', terminal_reason = '', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id} and status = 'UNLOADED' and terminal_source = 'AGENT_GONE' and version = #{version}

update rollout_instance_execution set status = 'PENDING', command_id = null, error_message = 'Agent 重新注册，等待自动恢复发布', started_at = null, finished_at = null, version = version + 1, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where operation_plan_id = #{operationPlanId} and instance_id = #{instanceId}
mapper.insert: insert into rule(id, application_id, environment_id, name, status, current_draft_version, latest_version, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at) values (#{id}, #{applicationId}, #{environmentId}, #{name}, #{status}, 1, 1, #{actor}, #{now}, #{actor}, #{now})
mapper.update: update rule set current_draft_version = #{version}, latest_version = #{version}, status = 'ENABLED', updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
